Fit accessors

Source: R/accessors.R
fitAccessors.Rd

Return the parts of a RegionSetDE.fit object: what the engine returned, the engine itself, the design and its formula, the blocking, the samples, and the universe built for the set level tests. fitEngine and setUniverse answer for the results as well, since both travel from the fit into them.

Usage

fitComponents(object)

# S4 method for class 'RegionSetDE.fit'
fitComponents(object)

fitEngine(object)

# S4 method for class 'RegionSetDE.fit'
fitEngine(object)

# S4 method for class 'RegionSetDE.results'
fitEngine(object)

# S4 method for class 'RegionSetDE.setResults'
fitEngine(object)

# S4 method for class 'RegionSetDE.geneResults'
fitEngine(object)

designMatrix(object)

# S4 method for class 'RegionSetDE.fit'
designMatrix(object)

designFormula(object)

# S4 method for class 'RegionSetDE.fit'
designFormula(object)

blockingInfo(object)

# S4 method for class 'RegionSetDE.fit'
blockingInfo(object)

fitSamples(object)

# S4 method for class 'RegionSetDE.fit'
fitSamples(object)

setUniverse(object)

# S4 method for class 'RegionSetDE.fit'
setUniverse(object)

# S4 method for class 'RegionSetDE.setResults'
setUniverse(object)

Arguments

object

RegionSetDE.fit object returned by fitRegions. fitEngine also takes a RegionSetDE.results, RegionSetDE.setResults or RegionSetDE.geneResults object, and setUniverse a RegionSetDE.setResults object.

Value

fitComponents returns a named list with everything the engine produced: object, the fit itself, which fitObject returns alone, and the auxiliary objects needed to test it, such as the voom weights or the sample table. fitEngine returns a string, one among "edgeR", "voom", "dream", "deseq2" and "limma". designMatrix returns the matrix of the fixed effects, one row per sample, as design does. designFormula returns the formula of the design, or NULL when the design was given as a matrix. blockingInfo returns a named list with the blocking variable, the random effect formula and the consensus correlation, empty when there is no blocking. fitSamples returns the names of the samples the model was fitted on. setUniverse returns the RegionSetDE.universe object with the rows every set is compared against, read with the universe accessors.

See also

fitObject, fitCounts, dispersionInfo

Author

Sebastian Gregoricchio

Examples

fit <- loadExampleData("fit", verbose = FALSE)

fitEngine(fit)
#> [1] "edgeR"
designFormula(fit)
#> ~condition
#> <environment: base>
head(designMatrix(fit))
#>                                 (Intercept) conditionSHR
#> lv-H3K4me3-BN-female-bio1-tech1           1            0
#> lv-H3K4me3-BN-male-bio2-tech1             1            0
#> lv-H3K4me3-SHR-male-bio2-tech1            1            1
#> lv-H3K4me3-SHR-male-bio3-tech1            1            1
fitSamples(fit)
#> [1] "lv-H3K4me3-BN-female-bio1-tech1" "lv-H3K4me3-BN-male-bio2-tech1"  
#> [3] "lv-H3K4me3-SHR-male-bio2-tech1"  "lv-H3K4me3-SHR-male-bio3-tech1" 
names(fitComponents(fit))
#> [1] "object" "dge"    "test"  
blockingInfo(fit)
#> list()
setUniverse(fit)
#> An object of class 'RegionSetDE.universe'

#>   compared against: promoterNonCpG, intergenic, geneBody, promoterCpG 
#>   sets            : 4 
#>

#>      intergenic       440         1354         1000                    1000
#>        geneBody       909          986         1000                    1000
#>     promoterCpG       269          314         1000                    1000
#>  median.abundance median.abundance.comparison
